user.title: Swiss Waters (BAFU)
user.description: Monitors the official FOEN/BAFU hydrological stations (water temperature, water level, discharge, flood danger level). Combine both selection modes as you like: a radius search around a location (set the radius to 0 to disable it) and/or hand-picked favorite stations. The station set is the union of both.

error.cannot_connect: The LINDAS data service could not be reached. Please try again later.
error.no_stations: No monitoring stations found for this selection. Try a larger radius or pick favorites.
error.nothing_selected: Set a radius greater than 0 and/or pick at least one favorite station.
